James Mcclave Company details Anthropic is an AI research company which offers AI models focused on alignment and safety to organizations and developers. Anthropic's models are designed to prioritize safety and interpretability, supporting AI applications that align with human values. The company strives to promote responsible AI development through its research and tools, helping organizations deploy AI in a way that adheres to ethical standards. This company was founded by Dario Amodei, Daniela Amodei, Jack Clark, and Jared Kaplan in 2021 and is headquartered in San Francisco, CA.
